findings.evidence:
Third Party Advertising
We use MaxOnline and other third-party advertising companies to serve ads when you visit our Web site. These companies may use information (not including your name, address, email address or telephone number) about your visits to this and other Web sites in order to provide advertisements on this site and other sites about goods and services that may be of interest to you.
findings.rationale: The policy explicitly states that no email addresses or contact details are shared with third parties, but it does disclose sharing information with third-party advertising companies for targeted advertising.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence mentions that third-party advertising companies use information about visits to serve advertisements, which implies sharing contact data for advertising purposes.
